positions.title: Client Partner
positions.description:
Blended role: Client Partner, Delivery Lead, Sr Engineering Manager

Managing a portfolio of accounts totaling over $10M in a role blending:
- Sales responsibilities: contract extension negotiation, business cases & sales proposals, key account management, financial forecasting and reporting
- Project management responsibilities: staffing concerns (including hiring decisions) for 12+ active software consulting teams, escalation point for issue resolution for over 50 consultants and corresponding client stakeholders, creating & delivering regular business reviews on project progress. case studies
- People management responsibilities: regular and annual feedback and performance assessments, coaching and developing team leadership capabilities, performance improvement plans, terminations
positions.insights: Business Development, Software Project Management and +2 skills

positions.title: Staff Software Consultant
positions.description:
Blended role: Staff Software Consultant, Engineering Manager

Lead client and consulting teams to deliver high-value technical solutions while simultaneously balancing career growth and skill development of 8 Sr Software Consultants. Other responsibilities included:
- creation of regular marketing material (https://blog.testdouble.com/authors/sam-jones & case studies for key accounts
- regular (often 2x weekly) candidate qualification
- community engagement including organization of local meetups and public speaking
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, Elixir and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
Delivered high quality, well-tested software solutions alongside client teams while simultaneously encouraging improved coding practices and delivery processes. Other responsibilities included:
- speaking engagements at local meetups
- regular (weekly) candidate qualification
